name: Magor Missabib
overview: In Jeremiah 20:3-6, the prophet Jeremiah renames Pashur as Magor Missabib, meaning 'Fear round about,' symbolizing the coming judgment and terror that will surround him. This new name reflects God's declaration that Pashur will become a source of fear to himself and his allies as they face defeat and captivity by the Babylonians. The passage emphasizes God's sovereign judgment on Jerusalem, promising the city's treasures and strength will be delivered into enemy hands, and that Pashur and his household will be taken captive and die in Babylon because of their false prophecies.
